aigc.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: 16:9 ultra-wide cinematic background for a Chinese desktop mecha product website and PowerPoint deck.
Primary request: empty premium industrial photography stage, black graphite hangar, deep crimson light coming from a huge rectangular opening high in the right background, one pale silver angled spotlight and soft atmospheric smoke. A low dark brushed-metal workbench surface in the lower half, with believable red reflected light. Empty stage ready for a small physical robot product composited later. Composition: left 42 percent deliberately almost black calm negative space for large Chinese typography; right 58 percent richly lit but still dark empty stage, low camera angle, refined asymmetric architectural framing. Mood: precise, cinematic, tangible, Japanese mecha product campaign, quiet strength, striking but restrained. Palette: charcoal black, subtle neutral steel, deep crimson red as the only color accent. Ultra high quality film still, physically believable light, fine grain, hard directional rim light and soft smoke.
Constraints: no robot, no people, no humanoids, no legs, no mechanical product, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no UI or HUD, no blue or purple neon, no busy details. Landscape 16:9.
aigc.usage: Environment only. Contains no robot or product geometry.
